simple.meaning: צִנּוּר (tsinnûwr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a culvert.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H6794. tsinnuwr צִנּוֺר noun masculine pipe, spout, conduit (so Late Hebrew); — absolute בַּצִּנּוֺר וְיִגַּע 2Sam 5:8 (i.e., si vera lectio, of Jerusalem, but very dubious, compare Dr HPS); plural suffix צִנּוֺרֶיךָ קוֺל Psa 42:8 the sound of thy (water-) spouts figurative, of sluices of heaven opened, compare מֶּלֶג אֲרֻבֶּה, .
